description: Does the camera enter the radar's ACC target (0x235 / 0x237)? The camera's object channel to the radar is not on the logged bus, and the camera-sent bus-1 frames never drop out (longest gap 0.78 s in 698 one-minute segments), so the natural experiment is the object-list slot's camera-association state 112|3 (docs/03), which by day ends between 40 and 60 m. 698 owner segments, 393k ACC-target cycles, day plus 4 night routes; ACC target matched to a mature object-list track (age >= 60) by position; ego > 8 m/s. Exploratory.

steps_at_association_onset_and_loss.note: [mean, standard error]; the ACC step does not lean toward the vision lead's offset (distance weight 0.000 +- 0.020 at onset, placebo 0.006)

camera_share_upper_bound.assumption: camera errors like openpilot's vision lead

reading: no detectable camera input in the ACC target's distance and closing speed; selection radar-led, with acquisitions at the camera's day range limit (40-50 m) partly coinciding with the camera's association; untested: camera input that does not set 112|3 (needs a drive with the camera covered)
